from solution import is_Monotonic


def test_issue_example_given():
    """Issue example asserts is_Monotonic([6, 5, 4, 4]) == True."""
    expected = True  # 6>=5>=4 and 4==4 so non-increasing => True
    assert is_Monotonic([6, 5, 4, 4]) == expected


def test_issue_strictly_increasing():
    """Monotonic includes non-decreasing array [1, 2, 3, 4]."""
    expected = True  # 1<=2<=3<=4 so non-decreasing => True
    assert is_Monotonic([1, 2, 3, 4]) == expected


def test_issue_strictly_decreasing():
    """Monotonic includes non-increasing array [5, 4, 3, 1]."""
    expected = True  # 5>=4>=3>=1 so non-increasing => True
    assert is_Monotonic([5, 4, 3, 1]) == expected


def test_issue_non_decreasing_with_equal():
    """Monotonic allows equals like [1, 2, 2, 4] is True."""
    expected = True  # 1<=2==2<=4 so non-decreasing => True
    assert is_Monotonic([1, 2, 2, 4]) == expected


def test_issue_all_equal():
    """Monotonic includes all-equal array [3, 3, 3]."""
    expected = True  # 3==3==3 so both directions => True
    assert is_Monotonic([3, 3, 3]) == expected


def test_issue_peak_not_monotonic():
    """Non-monotonic array [1, 3, 2] is not monotonic."""
    expected = False  # 1<=3 but 3>2 so neither direction => False
    assert is_Monotonic([1, 3, 2]) == expected


def test_issue_valley_not_monotonic():
    """Non-monotonic array [3, 1, 2] is not monotonic."""
    expected = False  # 3>1 but 1<2 so neither direction => False
    assert is_Monotonic([3, 1, 2]) == expected


def test_issue_single_element():
    """Single-element array [42] is monotonic."""
    expected = True  # no pair 42 vs next to violate => True
    assert is_Monotonic([42]) == expected


def test_issue_empty_array():
    """Empty array [] is monotonic."""
    expected = True  # 0 pairs to violate, vacuously => True
    assert is_Monotonic([]) == expected


def test_issue_negative_non_decreasing():
    """Monotonic covers negatives like [-3, -2, -2, 0]."""
    expected = True  # -3<=-2==-2<=0 so non-decreasing => True
    assert is_Monotonic([-3, -2, -2, 0]) == expected


def test_contract_single_array_argument():
    """Public interface 'def is_Monotonic(A)' takes one array argument."""
    expected = True  # 1<=2<=3 so non-decreasing => True
    assert is_Monotonic([1, 2, 3]) == expected


def test_contract_equals_true_comparison():
    """Example 'assert is_Monotonic(...) == True' uses == True comparison."""
    expected = False  # 2>=1 but 1<2 so neither direction => False
    assert is_Monotonic([2, 1, 2]) == expected
